dedupe_keys.name: ausgewiesene windenergieflachen der regional und kommunalplanung datensatz

description: Ausgewiesene Windenergieflächen der Regional- und Kommunalplanung (Datensatz) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.uba.de. The area data of the designated areas are transmitted annually by the federal states to the federal government within the framework of the federal-state cooperation committee in accordance with § 98 EEG. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Designated wind energy areas of regional and local planning (dataset)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, Regionalplanung, 2024, Sondergebiete Wind, Windenergieflächen, Flächennutzungsplanung. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
